'''Gamorrean Interstellar''' was a mining corporation. The corporation likely operated throughout the [[Opoku system]]. The planet [[Quiberon V]] was mined by Gamorrean Interstellar during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
